scope_gap.instructions: Does this implementation plan leave a blocking ambiguity about what is required for initial commercial launch versus what is explicitly post-launch or optional?

criteria.true: Critical launch scope or non-goals are materially ambiguous or contradictory.
criteria.false: Launch scope, non-goals, and deferrable capabilities are explicit enough to execute.

dependency_gap.instructions: Does the plan contain a blocking phase-order or dependency ambiguity that could cause a phase to require a contract, store, service, or capability that has not yet been established?

criteria.true: At least one material execution dependency is missing, circular, or ordered incorrectly.
criteria.false: The dependency graph provides an executable order for material prerequisites.

domain_gap.instructions: Does the canonical domain model lack a material entity, identity rule, relation, or version/provenance concept required to unify apps, websites, screens, flows, assets, components, Lens outputs, and agent evidence?

criteria.true: A core object cannot be represented without creating an incompatible parallel model or losing required lineage.
criteria.false: The model can represent launch-critical object types and their lineage without separate canonical silos.

provenance_rights_gap.instructions: Does this plan conflate source-code permission with dataset, asset, font, trademark, hosted-service, or redistribution rights, or omit execution-time immutable source pinning?

criteria.true: A material rights/provenance boundary is missing or conflated.
criteria.false: Code/data rights are separated and implemented imports require immutable provenance.

security_privacy_gap.instructions: Does this plan leave a blocking security or privacy boundary unowned for hostile URL capture, redirects/DNS rebinding, untrusted HTML/SVG, MCP authorization, workspace isolation, BYOK secrets, or external model egress?

criteria.true: A material attack/data-egress path remains fail-open or without an owning phase/test.
criteria.false: Material security/privacy boundaries have explicit fail-closed controls and tests.

agent_first_gap.instructions: Does this plan fail the requirement that Skelet be agent-first across stable structured resources, a bounded MCP tool surface, evidence identifiers, persistent research context, and human/API parity?

criteria.true: Agents would still depend materially on scraping the human UI, unstable prose, or missing evidence identity.
criteria.false: Agents have first-class stable contracts and recoverable evidence.

search_gap.instructions: Does the search design have a blocking architecture gap for unified lexical, semantic, visual, typed-filter, rights-aware, and provenance-aware retrieval across all launch artifact kinds?

criteria.true: A required search mode has no executable indexing/query path or would require a second public search contract.
criteria.false: One public contract can be implemented over the stated search projection/providers.

lens_gap.instructions: Does the Lens design leave a blocking gap between URL submission and a publishable agent-ready design intelligence pack, including partial provider failures, observed-versus-inferred labeling, and provenance?

criteria.true: The pipeline can silently lose evidence, fail all-or-nothing on optional providers, or publish ambiguous inference as fact.
criteria.false: The pipeline has explicit stages, failure isolation, provenance, and observation/inference distinctions.

operations_gap.instructions: Does the plan omit a launch-blocking operational concern around queues, retries, cancellation, dedupe, backups/restores, rate limits, abuse controls, provider health, or production runbooks?

criteria.true: A material production failure mode has no owner or launch gate.
criteria.false: Operational controls have explicit phases and qualification criteria.

test_review_gap.instructions: Does the CI/review plan omit a material verification class needed for safe implementation of database changes, importers, hostile URL capture, auth/workspace isolation, MCP/API contracts, browser UI, provenance, or exact-head code review?

criteria.true: A critical change class can merge without targeted automated or review evidence.
criteria.false: Critical change classes have explicit automated/review gates.

cost_lockin_gap.instructions: Does the plan introduce a mandatory paid SaaS, paid model/API, hosted search/vector dependency, GPU requirement, or vendor-specific data path that violates the low-cost/local-first product constraint?

criteria.true: A mandatory launch path creates avoidable paid/vendor lock-in.
criteria.false: Paid/external providers are optional or replaceable behind adapters and the qualified path can run without mandatory paid AI/search/crawling.

execution_grain_gap.instructions: Is this plan still too coarse to hand to an implementation agent without risking multi-purpose giant changes, stale source assumptions, or unbounded donor imports?

criteria.true: Implementation grains lack enough boundaries, entry/exit criteria, pinning, or merge discipline to execute safely.
criteria.false: The phase/grain rules are bounded enough to begin implementation and decompose work safely.
